nd6cce95233.headline: Foreign investors are leaving Azerbaijan
nd6cce95233.summary: Since 2014, Azerbaijan has seen foreign companies withdraw due to an ongoing economic crisis, including firms like Distrilab and Grundfos Pompa Sanayi.
nd6cce95233.why: Foreign investment outflows signal economic distress, affecting currency stability, capital markets, and growth prospects.
nd6cce95233.why_moved: Economic crisis and capital flight increase financial instability and currency depreciation risks.

nbff68daa65.headline: OHL bleeds 36% in the stock market in three sessions
nbff68daa65.summary: OHL shares dropped 36% over three sessions following a credit rating downgrade after weak quarterly results.
nbff68daa65.why: OHL is a major Spanish construction and infrastructure company; credit downgrades and earnings weakness affect investor confidence.
nbff68daa65.why_moved: Credit rating downgrade and poor earnings triggered a steep sell-off in OHL shares.
